description: Hardware classification is deterministic — same input always produces same output
property: For any HardwareProfile, classify_hardware() SHALL return the same HardwareClass when called multiple times with identical input

invariants.description: Every profile maps to exactly one of the 6 hardware classes
invariants.assertion: result in [GpuWorkstation, CpuWorkstation, GpuServer, CpuServer, Embedded, ContainerRestricted]

invariants.description: Classification does not modify the input profile
